title: VMF project
description: PROJECT-1. The container that holds an assessment and the migrations planned from it. Owner: 'should it be a new project as you'd have an assessment with a migration in it. something larger as we now have assessment & migrations split.' This is Azure Migrate's shape, which matters because the owner has repeatedly pointed at that model as the one operators already know. A project owns the NAME of the piece of work - what a person actually thinks in - and the scope it covers, so a second scan of the same estate does not have to re-pick it or invent a different name.

projectId.description: The store prefix this project's runs live under. Lower-case and hyphenated because it is a blob path segment, not a display string - the NAME is what a person reads.

name.description: What a person calls this piece of work - 'Contoso datacentre exit'. Stored ONCE here rather than repeated on every run, because a name copied onto each member is a name that can disagree with itself.

createdBy.description: The signed-in identity that created it, never a typed parameter.

scope.description: What this project covers, recorded once. An assessment inside it defaults to this instead of re-picking, which is what makes a re-scan a re-scan rather than a new decision. Null means the project has no default and every assessment states its own.

note.description: Why this project exists, in the creator's own words.
